europe_now.title: Violence erupts in Ceuta as migrant tensions escalate
europe_now.summary: Anti-migrant protesters clashed with police in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, prompting the national government to call for calm. The unrest reflects growing tensions over migration at Europe's southern border.

europe_now.title: Greenland opens truth commission over forced contraception allegations
europe_now.summary: Greenland has announced a truth commission to investigate a historical forced contraception programme, though officials stressed the findings are not yet final. The move comes amid renewed international attention to colonial-era abuses in the Arctic territory.

top_stories.title: Norway begins royal transition following King Harald V's death
top_stories.summary: Norway is mourning King Harald V as preparations begin for his son Haakon to ascend the throne. The Oslo mayor cancelled her own wedding out of respect for the national period of mourning.

sources.headline: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne

top_stories.title: EU presses Meta to apply US teen safety rules across European platforms
top_stories.summary: The European Union is pushing Meta to extend teenage safety restrictions imposed in the United States to its European users. The move reflects growing EU pressure on major platforms under the Digital Services Act.

sources.headline: The US got Meta to change Instagram and Facebook. Europe wants in.

top_stories.title: Poland's political rift deepens over nuclear weapons hosting debate
top_stories.summary: The Polish president's office has publicly criticised the government for rejecting the hosting of allied nuclear weapons on Polish territory. The dispute highlights growing political fault lines within Poland's ruling coalition ahead of upcoming elections.

sources.headline: Polish president’s office criticises government for rejecting hosting of allied nuclear weapons
